verses.text: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

segments.text: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth?
Or
canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

verses.text: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

segments.text: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil?
Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

verses.text: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, They cast out their pains.

segments.text: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young,
They cast out their pains.

verses.text: Their young ones become strong, they grow up in the open field; They go forth, and return not again.

segments.text: Their young ones become strong, they grow up in the open field;
They go forth, and return not again.

verses.text: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bonds of the swift ass,

segments.text: Who hath sent out the wild ass free?
Or who hath loosed the bonds of the swift ass,

verses.text: Whose home I have made the wilderness, And the salt land his dwelling-place?

segments.text: Whose home I have made the wilderness,
And the salt land his dwelling-place?

verses.text: He scorneth the tumult of the city, Neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.

segments.text: He scorneth the tumult of the city,
Neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.

verses.text: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.

segments.text: The range of the mountains is his pasture,
And he searcheth after every green thing.

verses.text: Will the wild-ox be content to serve thee? Or will he abide by thy crib?

segments.text: Will the wild-ox be content to serve thee?
Or will he abide by thy crib?

verses.text: Canst thou bind the wild-ox with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

segments.text: Canst thou bind the wild-ox with his band in the furrow?
Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

verses.text: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave to him thy labor?

segments.text: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great?
Or wilt thou leave to him thy labor?

verses.text: Wilt thou confide in him, that he will bring home thy seed, And gather the grain of thy threshing-floor?

segments.text: Wilt thou confide in him, that he will bring home thy seed,
And gather
the grain
of thy threshing-floor?

verses.text: The wings of the ostrich wave proudly; But are they the pinions and plumage of love?

segments.text: The wings of the ostrich wave proudly;
But
are they the pinions and plumage of love?

verses.text: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth, And warmeth them in the dust,

segments.text: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth,
And warmeth them in the dust,

verses.text: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, Or that the wild beast may trample them.

segments.text: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them,
Or that the wild beast may trample them.

verses.text: She dealeth hardly with her young ones, as if they were not hers: Though her labor be in vain, she is without fear;

segments.text: She dealeth hardly with her young ones, as if they were not hers:
Though her labor be in vain,
she is
without fear;

verses.text: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, Neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

segments.text: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom,
Neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

verses.text: What time she lifteth up herself on high, She scorneth the horse and his rider.

segments.text: What time she lifteth up herself on high,
She scorneth the horse and his rider.

verses.text: Hast thou given the horse his might? Hast thou clothed his neck with the quivering mane?

segments.text: Hast thou given the horse
his
might?
Hast thou clothed his neck with the quivering mane?

verses.text: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is terrible.

segments.text: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust?
The glory of his snorting is terrible.

verses.text: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: He goeth out to meet the armed men.

segments.text: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength:
He goeth out to meet the armed men.

verses.text: He mocketh at fear, and is not dismayed; Neither turneth he back from the sword.

segments.text: He mocketh at fear, and is not dismayed;
Neither turneth he back from the sword.

verses.text: The quiver rattleth against him, The flashing spear and the javelin.

segments.text: The quiver rattleth against him,
The flashing spear and the javelin.

verses.text: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage; Neither believeth he that it is the voice of the trumpet.

segments.text: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage;
Neither believeth he that it is the voice of the trumpet.

verses.text: As oft as the trumpet soundeth he saith, Aha! And he smelleth the battle afar off, The thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

verses.text: Is it by thy wisdom that the hawk soareth, And stretcheth her wings toward the south?

segments.text: Is it by thy wisdom that the hawk soareth,
And
stretcheth her wings toward the south?

verses.text: Is it at thy command that the eagle mounteth up, And maketh her nest on high?

segments.text: Is it at thy command that the eagle mounteth up,

verses.text: On the cliff she dwelleth, and maketh her home, Upon the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.

segments.text: On the cliff she dwelleth, and maketh her home,
Upon the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.

verses.text: From thence she spieth out the prey; Her eyes behold it afar off.

segments.text: From thence she spieth out the prey;
Her eyes behold it afar off.

verses.text: Her young ones also suck up blood: And where the slain are, there is she.
